task_adaptation_supported: for both short and pinhole, repaired normalized pair gap and fraction above real q95 are lower than pretrained no-adaptation, with no catastrophic real-manifold collapse
task_adaptation_mixed: only one class improves both task metrics, or metric directions are inconsistent
task_adaptation_not_supported: neither class improves both task metrics
useful_variation_supported: for both classes repaired exceeds class-finetuned SD2 in IC-LPIPS, corrected feature variance, and corrected pairwise feature distance; generated source identity R2 is lower; real-bank support has no catastrophic collapse
catastrophic_real_manifold_collapse: fraction above real q95 equals 1.0 in either class or repaired is worse than pretrained in either task metric
stage9f_worth_testing: training valid AND TASK_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED AND USEFUL_VARIATION_SUPPORTED AND no catastrophic collapse
